issues.title: GraphMutationDraft format contradicted its operation validator
issues.preChangeReproduction: Live qwen3:8b produced validator-invalid irrelevant fields for 9/13 families after repair on the latest diagnosis run (10/13 on the preceding run).
issues.rootCause: One shared schema required every transport key while the fail-closed validator permitted only fields relevant to the selected operation.
issues.changeMade: Replaced the operation schema with an exact compact 13-variant contract and aligned planner/prompt behavior without weakening the deterministic validator.
issues.liveVerification: Two consecutive authoritative qwen3:8b matrices passed 13/13 final-valid; all 26 family rows were first-attempt valid, with direct/bridge control parity and no graph commit.
issues.securityEffect: Preserves fail-closed validation and confirmation; no model response gains direct mutation authority.

issues.title: Repair timeout hid an earlier invalid structured response
issues.preChangeReproduction: An invalid first response followed by a repair timeout surfaced only model_generation_timeout.
issues.rootCause: The terminal transport catch path replaced earlier structured validation evidence.
issues.changeMade: Retained bounded per-attempt evidence and the first invalid-response details alongside the terminal transport failure.
issues.liveVerification: The supplemental invalid-first/repair-timeout control preserves both validation and timeout provenance.
issues.securityEffect: Improves auditability while continuing to reject the invalid draft.

issues.title: Primitive abort reasons were classified as unknown network errors
issues.preChangeReproduction: A 1 ms timeout and explicit cancellation both mapped to unknown_network_error.
issues.rootCause: Fetch error mapping recognized AbortError objects but not primitive AbortSignal.reason values.
issues.changeMade: Normalized abort reasons at the transport boundary and classified timeout and explicit cancellation distinctly.
issues.liveVerification: Final live probe reports the expected timeout and cancellation classifications.
issues.securityEffect: Accurate failure provenance prevents unsafe recovery advice; no authority change.

issues.title: Full diagnostics short-circuited as a current-transport reconnect
issues.preChangeReproduction: Direct success left bridge and planner rows untested and refreshed active connection state.
issues.rootCause: The full button invoked current mode and shared reconnect semantics.
issues.changeMade: Separated read-only full diagnostics from reconnect/current-connection actions and made full mode visit the advertised checks.
issues.liveVerification: Browser full diagnostics completed direct, bridge, listing, generation, and planner readiness while preserving connection state.
issues.securityEffect: Read-only diagnostics no longer silently acquire runtime-control authority.

issues.title: Isolated bridge probe displayed the active direct endpoint
issues.preChangeReproduction: With direct active, Test local bridge showed the direct transport and localhost:11434.
issues.rootCause: Presentation used active configuration rather than the isolated probe result.
issues.changeMade: Captured and rendered transport and endpoint identity from each isolated probe.
issues.liveVerification: Opposite-transport probes display the tested endpoint and preserve the active transport.
issues.securityEffect: Makes endpoint attribution auditable without switching the trusted connection.

issues.title: Sequential diagnostics erased evidence and exported too little
issues.preChangeReproduction: A later probe reset earlier rows; copied report omitted live status and failure classification.
issues.rootCause: Each result replaced the snapshot and export was constructed from static configuration.
issues.changeMade: Preserved bounded sequential evidence and exported richer status/classification details through explicit redaction.
issues.liveVerification: Sequential browser probes retained their rows and copy/export actions completed with bounded redacted output.
issues.securityEffect: Export excludes bearer values, prompts, uploads, parser source, and credential assignments.

issues.title: A disabled assistant could not recover through visible Connect
issues.preChangeReproduction: Connect/Reconnect refused while disabled until a separate hidden enable command was used.
issues.rootCause: The visible action mapped to a test-only operation with an enabled precondition.
issues.changeMade: Made recovery explicit as Enable then Connect; diagnostics remain unable to silently enable the assistant.
issues.liveVerification: Browser disabled -> Enable -> Connect -> Reconnect -> Disconnect lifecycle passed.
issues.securityEffect: Maintains explicit user intent at the runtime-control boundary.

issues.title: Tiny graph summary called line-graph triangles too large
issues.preChangeReproduction: The 3-hyperedge/5-vertex example showed one triangle in Statistics but 'too large' in the result summary.
issues.rootCause: Any null triangle value was mapped to budget-exceeded even when status was not_requested.
issues.changeMade: Separated not-requested, unavailable, and bounded/too-large result states with truthful wording.
issues.liveVerification: Browser Statistics and corrected summary agree on the small graph's one Line-Graph Triangle.
issues.securityEffect: No authority impact; removes misleading resource-state output.

issues.title: Empty Custom Parser results appeared successful with Apply enabled
issues.preChangeReproduction: No-files Run Parser produced a green zero-edge preview and enabled Apply despite handler rejection.
issues.rootCause: UI success and Apply gating checked result existence instead of validated nonempty semantics.
issues.changeMade: No-file and zero-edge results are warnings/errors and Apply requires a valid nonempty parser result.
issues.liveVerification: No-file and empty browser states keep Apply disabled; a valid one-edge result previews and applies to 1 hyperedge/2 vertices.
issues.securityEffect: Prevents an invalid parser result from being presented as executable authority.

issues.title: Dynamic import bypassed Custom Parser static safety
issues.preChangeReproduction: Acorn emitted ImportExpression and the safety validator returned ok for async import().
issues.rootCause: The AST walker blocked only import-shaped CallExpression nodes and skipped regex fallback after a successful parse.
issues.changeMade: Rejected ImportExpression and dynamic-import forms before Worker creation, retaining the trusted-code warning and isolation controls.
issues.liveVerification: Parse-only adversarial probes reject direct and nested dynamic imports without executing them.
issues.securityEffect: Final security scan found no residual issue on the parser import boundary.

issues.title: Private Ollama validation did not constrain redirects
issues.preChangeReproduction: A validated loopback URL could return 307/308 and default fetch behavior could follow Location with the request body.
issues.rootCause: Only the initial URL was validated; fetch redirect following was not disabled.
issues.changeMade: Set redirect:error on direct model, bridge upstream, and launcher identity requests, preserving fixed loopback endpoints.
issues.liveVerification: A loopback 307 fixture confirmed the model POST body was not delivered to the second hop.
issues.securityEffect: Final security scan found no redirect/body locality finding.

issues.title: Dataset interpretation validator accepted schema-invalid objects
issues.preChangeReproduction: A draft missing required fields and containing an extra property returned ok.
issues.rootCause: Handwritten checks defaulted missing arrays and did not enforce required/additionalProperties recursively.
issues.changeMade: Added reusable strict JSON-schema validation plus semantic/reference validation for interpretation drafts.
issues.liveVerification: Browser dataset inference succeeded for a valid draft and rejected unknown properties.
issues.securityEffect: Closes extra-property and prototype-shaped model-output ambiguity before state use.

issues.title: Dataset mapping patch validator accepted schema-invalid objects
issues.preChangeReproduction: A patch missing clarificationQuestion and containing extra top-level/nested properties returned ok.
issues.rootCause: Reference validation did not enforce the declared closed schema.
issues.changeMade: Enforced recursive required/additionalProperties/type/enum checks before mapping reference semantics.
issues.liveVerification: Valid deterministic mapping worked; an unknown property was rejected in the browser flow.
issues.securityEffect: Prevents injected undeclared patch fields from reaching mapping authority.

issues.title: Duplicate upload filenames conflicted with name-keyed joins
issues.preChangeReproduction: Two distinct same.csv objects passed validation and downstream Map(fileName) collapsed a profile.
issues.rootCause: Upload IDs were unique while downstream contracts selected by filename and batch validation allowed collisions.
issues.changeMade: Rejected batch filename collisions after Unicode normalization and case folding.
issues.liveVerification: Two browser-selected duplicate.edge fixtures were rejected; valid single-file upload continued to work.
issues.securityEffect: Removes ambiguous file authority and cross-file profile substitution.

issues.title: Copied Ollama origin command was POSIX-only in a Windows UI
issues.preChangeReproduction: The Windows browser copied OLLAMA_ORIGINS=... ollama serve and labeled it generically.
issues.rootCause: One shell syntax was generated for all platforms.
issues.changeMade: Generated and labeled distinct PowerShell, cmd, and POSIX commands.
issues.liveVerification: Browser copy controls produced the distinct labeled shell variants.
issues.securityEffect: Reduces unsafe manual rewriting; commands contain URL origins and no credentials.

issues.title: Launchers assumed ambient runtimes and fixed ports/origins
issues.preChangeReproduction: Ambient npm/ollama/python were unavailable; unrelated HTTP 200 health could appear ready; Vite used 5178 while scripts assumed 5173.
issues.rootCause: Launcher preflight did not verify bridge identity or reconcile selected ports/origins, and documentation blurred user prerequisites.
issues.changeMade: Added executable Windows/POSIX preflight and identity checks, actual Vite origin handling, wildcard rejection, explicit user-installed prerequisites, and validated HYPERGRAPH_BRIDGE_PORT -> VITE_HYPERGRAPH_BRIDGE_PORT propagation with default 8787.
issues.liveVerification: Default-port direct/bridge browser lifecycle passed; executable tests verify occupied/unrelated responder handling, alternate Vite origins, custom port 9123, and invalid-port fallback.
issues.securityEffect: Custom configuration still constructs only validated fixed-loopback URLs; wildcard origins are rejected and no Codex-private production runtime path was embedded.
